source_reconstruction_scope: CSLimbus::OnFocus normal-flow prefix, respawn-delay/online-host decision, one-shot timer request, and normal-flow AI_ClearAllAggro convergence. The port adapts source-owned property/manager/visibility services and calls the existing Character Coordinator timer store; no native GameObject or PlayerManager layout is overlaid.
caller_facts: OnFocus first writes zero to Character+0x520, then calls GameObject::SetVisible(false) through the Character vtable slot at +0x40. It reads the distinct Character+0x530 gate only after these two operations.
When Character+0x530 is zero, OnFocus skips delay, InitSpawned, property, online, hosting and timer reads, then normally calls CharAI::AI_ClearAllAggro once.

For nonzero +0x530, OnFocus calls Character::GetRespawnDelay once and requires a signed positive result before reading PlayerManager online byte+5. A zero online byte schedules without a hosting query; a nonzero byte calls PlayerManager::IsLocalPlayerHosting and uses nonzero truthiness.

When the source schedule branch is taken, it calls GetRespawnDelay a second time after the online/hosting decision and passes the second result's raw 32-bit bits to CharTimers::TMR_Start(duration, 0, 0x2f, nullptr). It ignores the timer ID and does not recheck the second delay.

Both GetRespawnDelay calls independently read the Character+0x1481 InitSpawned suppression byte. If that byte is nonzero, the getter returns zero without reading property 11; otherwise it reads RespawnTime property ID 11 and applies signed ASR 8 followed by signed 32-bit MUL 1000 wrap.

All normal OnFocus branches converge on AI_ClearAllAggro once at the end. Adapter errors/exceptions are a port protocol and return/propagate before synthetic extra source actions; they do not trigger a fabricated cleanup call.

PlayerManager::IsLocalPlayerHosting remains an opaque source-service callback. Its internal second online read, OnlineGameState mode 3/4 selection, matching host check and local-player host fallback are distinct from OnFocus's outer byte+5 decision and are not duplicated by this kernel.
unsupported: The host kernel is not wired into the current Android actor/state native path; integration must supply live Character+0x520/+0x530/+0x1481, resolved property 11, PlayerManager policy and AI cleanup services.
PlayerManager::IsLocalPlayerHosting internals and native PlayerManager/OnlineGameState ownership remain outside the adapter.
The existing Character Coordinator owns the native timer slots, but event 0x2f delivery back into the game's revive/respawn state and source UI/effects are not proven by this kernel.
Original callbacks do not return adapter failure codes. Port-only callback failures preserve completed prior effects, do not roll back, and do not invoke the normal-path AI cleanup artificially.
